title: EventStream Schema
description: Nextdoc EventStream contract v1. Defines outbound events (machine → customer) and inbound events (customer → machine).

EventStreamType.description: Specific event types customers can subscribe to. Source of truth for topic validation and the type discriminator on outbound events.

EventStreamOutbound.description: Outbound event: machine → customer via streamevent CustomEvent detail.

contractVersion.description: Schema version. Bumped on breaking changes to event shapes.

producer.description: Always nextdoc for outbound events. Identifies the event source.

correlationId.description: When present, correlates this event to an originating action request. Matches the requestId from the action acknowledgment flow.

meta.description: Shared metadata present on every outbound event.

recordId.description: Salesforce record ID that this event belongs to.

actionName.description: Name of the deployed action that started.

type.description: A deployed action has been initiated. The actionName identifies which action.

artifacts.description: Records saved by the action, typically related to the base recordId (e.g. attachments, linked records).

recordId.description: Salesforce record ID of the affected record (e.g. ContentDocumentLink 06A...).

recordType.description: SObject type of the created record (e.g. ContentDocumentLink).

label.description: Customer-defined constant for programmatic dispatch (e.g. primary-attachment, audit-log).

operation.description: What the action did to this record.

sourceContentDocumentId.description: The parent ContentDocument (068...) that this record links to. Use to correlate with documents known to the LWC.

items.description: A record created, updated, or referenced by a completed action. Carried in the artifacts array of action.succeeded events.
